topic: Gaara praised and pitied Kimimaro mid-fight, a side beat showing his compassion reaching enemies
title: Gaara Pitied The Enemy Who Nearly Beat Him
description: In the Sasuke Recovery arc, Gaara stopped mid-fight to praise Kimimaro and then pitied his loneliness. Here's what that says about the Gaara who once crushed Rock Lee. Was it kindness or a mirror?
comment: Did Gaara pity Kimimaro because he changed, or because he saw his own old self?

lines.text: Gaara praised the enemy who was beating him, and almost nobody noticed.

shot.fallback: red haired boy speaking calmly to a bone fighter

lines.text: His Sand Waterfall Funeral fails. So he scales up to the Imperial Funeral. It fails too.

shot.fallback: huge sand dome covering the ground

lines.text: Gaara blocks the Dance of the Clematis with the Shield of Shukaku. Then he speaks.

shot.search: Gaara Shield of Shukaku Dance of the Clematis
shot.fallback: sand shield blocking a flower of bones

lines.text: He congratulates Kimimaro, and says he regrets that someone this talented is about to be lost.

shot.fallback: red haired boy nodding respectfully at a pale fighter

lines.text: Kimimaro says he'd give everything for Orochimaru. Gaara decides he's been brainwashed.

shot.fallback: pale long haired ninja kneeling for a snake master

lines.text: Here's my read. Gaara saw his own old logic in Kimimaro, a life built around one master purpose.

shot.fallback: red haired boy studying a pale opponent

lines.text: The wiki says he pitied Kimimaro's emptiness and loneliness, and the anime covers it in episodes 124 through 127.

shot.fallback: sad eyed boy gazing at a fallen foe

lines.text: People say it's just respect for a strong fighter. But respect doesn't make you pity someone's loneliness.

shot.fallback: two fighters facing each other in a rocky valley

lines.text: Kimimaro never got to be saved. An old illness took him before his next strike landed.

shot.fallback: pale ninja collapsing on the ground

lines.text: So who taught Gaara that pity for an enemy was even allowed?

shot.fallback: red haired boy between a blond ninja and a green suited ninja

lines.text: Because that's exactly why Gaara praised the enemy who was beating him.

shot.fallback: red haired boy protected by a sand shield

self_check.hook: Opens on a surprising act, Gaara praising an enemy mid-fight.
self_check.loop: Last line completes the opening claim that Gaara praised the enemy who was beating him.
